lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; the most intense nodes are arranged in a linear series along the mid-lateral flank between the posterior gills and the dorsal fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae, creating a grid where spots are localized within the resulting rectangular quadrants.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a distinct light-to-shadow gradient across the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear feature, possibly a scar or deep tissue indentation, is visible posterior to the gill region, bisecting the first and second carinae.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, increasing in frequency toward the distal margin.
